info.title: Vowed API
info.description: Backend for the Vowed Android app. All endpoints except /v1/health, /v1/meta and /v1/auth/* need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from /v1/auth/verify. u64 amounts are decimal strings. Transaction builders return unsigned base64 transactions: the app must decode and check them before asking the wallet to sign.

post.summary: Get a sign-in nonce and the exact payload to pass to the wallet's sign-in
Exchange the wallet's signed sign-in message for a short-lived token

get.summary: Program and deployment facts the app needs (no secrets)

List challenges I may see: public Open pools plus my own and my squads' (mine=true: only those I joined or created). Squad pools are unlisted: anyone holding the pool address can still fetch it by address, so invitations work.
One challenge with its participants and my claimable amount

post.summary: Build the unsigned create-pool transaction for a goal plan (send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe)
Build the unsigned join transaction (commits the stake to the device key you registered)
Build the unsigned claim transaction for a settled or voided challenge
Tell the backend about a transaction you sent so the mirror updates immediately (it re-reads the chain; nothing is trusted from the request)
Get the challenge to pass to Android Keystore when generating the device key
Register the device proof key (P-256) with its Android key attestation
Start a proof session: returns the nonce the device must sign into the proof
Submit a device-signed proof package. Idempotent per session: a retry returns the same result
Join a squad with an invite code

get.summary: Squad details with members and linked challenges

post.summary: Get the invite code and link (owner can rotate the code)
Link a pool you created to this squad so members see it in the feed and leaderboard

get.summary: Squad activity feed, newest first (use `before` for older pages)
Leaderboard across the squad's linked challenges

post.summary: Nudge a squad mate who has not checked in today (rate limited per pair, per sender and per recipient)

get.summary: Deterministic difficulty suggestions for the next challenge (never changes an active one)
Test-token faucet status for the signed-in wallet (devnet only). Show `label` next to the tokens

post.summary: Claim a fixed amount of TEST USDC and TEST SKR (once per wallet per 24 hours, with a global daily cap)
